\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{تخمینہ} (takhmīnā)}{تخمینہ (takhmīnā)}]{\ur{تخمینہ} (takhmīnā) — an estimate}

\label{lesson:UR-C362-takhmina}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a probability, then the Urdu for to go by.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{تخمینہ}}
\textbf{\ur{تخمینہ}} — \emph{takhmīnā} — \textquotedblleft{}an estimate\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{تخمینہ} \ur{ٹھیک} \ur{ہے} \ur{تو} \ur{خرچ} \ur{کم} \ur{ہو} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar takhmīnā ṭhīk hai to kharch kam ho gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If the estimate is right, the cost will be lower.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{تخمینہ}} (\emph{takhmīnā}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{takhmīna}, built on Arabic \emph{takhmīn}, \textquotedblleft{}guessing, reckoning\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{takhmīnā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{takhmīnā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar takhmīnā ṭhīk hai to kharch kam ho gā.} — If the estimate is right, the cost will be lower.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for a probability, then the Urdu for to go by, then say \emph{takhmīnā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{تخمینہ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An estimate\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{یقین} (yaqīn)}{یقین (yaqīn)}]{\ur{یقین} (yaqīn) — certainty; belief (that something is so)}

\label{lesson:UR-C362-yaqin}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for to go by, then the Urdu for an estimate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{یقین}}
\textbf{\ur{یقین}} — \emph{yaqīn} — \textquotedblleft{}certainty; belief (that something is so)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{آپ} \ur{کو} \ur{یقین} \ur{نہیں} \ur{تو} \ur{خود} \ur{دیکھ} \ur{لیجیے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar āp ko yaqīn nahīṅ to khud dekh lījiye.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you don't believe it, see for yourself.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{یقین}} (\emph{yaqīn}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{yaqīn}, \textquotedblleft{}certainty\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

One more word for saying what happens if.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{اکثر} (aksar)}{اکثر (aksar)}]{\ur{اکثر} (aksar) — often; usually}

\label{lesson:UR-C362-aksar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for an estimate, then the Urdu for certainty.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{اکثر}}
\textbf{\ur{اکثر}} — \emph{aksar} — \textquotedblleft{}often; usually\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{وہ} \ur{اکثر} \ur{دیر} \ur{سے} \ur{آتا} \ur{ہے} \ur{تو} \ur{اسے} \ur{بتائیے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar voh aksar der se ātā hai to use batāiye.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}

\textbf{\ur{اکثر}} (\emph{aksar}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{akthar}, \textquotedblleft{}more, most\textquotedblright{}: most of the time.
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{قیاس} (qiyās)}{قیاس (qiyās)}]{\ur{قیاس} (qiyās) — a guess; conjecture}

\label{lesson:UR-C362-qiyas}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for certainty, then the Urdu for often.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{قیاس}}
\textbf{\ur{قیاس}} — \emph{qiyās} — \textquotedblleft{}a guess; conjecture\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{میرا} \ur{قیاس} \ur{ٹھیک} \ur{ہے} \ur{تو} \ur{وہ} \ur{کل} \ur{آئے} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar merā qiyās ṭhīk hai to voh kal āe gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If my guess is right, he will come tomorrow.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{قیاس}} (\emph{qiyās}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{qiyās}, \textquotedblleft{}measuring one thing by another\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{بوجھنا} (būjhnā)}{بوجھنا (būjhnā)}]{\ur{بوجھنا} (būjhnā) — to work out a riddle; to guess}

\label{lesson:UR-C362-bujhna-guess}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for often, then the Urdu for conjecture.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{بوجھنا}}
\textbf{\ur{بوجھنا}} — \emph{būjhnā} — \textquotedblleft{}to work out a riddle; to guess\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{آپ} \ur{نے} \ur{ٹھیک} \ur{بوجھا} \ur{تو} \ur{آپ} \ur{جیتیں} \ur{گے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar āp ne ṭhīk būjhā to āp jīteṅ ge.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you guess right, you will win.
\end{quote}

Past, with \ur{نے} (he or she …): \ur{اس} \ur{نے} \ur{ٹھیک} \ur{بوجھا}, \emph{us ne ṭhīk būjhā}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{بوجھنا}} (\emph{būjhnā}) is inherited: CDIAL lists the Hindi cousin \emph{būjhnā}, \textquotedblleft{}to understand, to ascertain\textquotedblright{}, under Sanskrit \emph{búdhyate}, \textquotedblleft{}wakes; understands\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 9279).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{būjhnā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar āp ne ṭhīk būjhā to āp jīteṅ ge.} — If you guess right, you will win.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for often, then the Urdu for conjecture, then say \emph{būjhnā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from Praise and Blame to Perhaps, Probably}

\label{lesson:UR-R362-review-355-362}



\begin{quote}
Say the Urdu for praise and fault.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item praise, fault, reproach, to commend, to endure
  \item a reform, a standard, a knack, to put right, to polish a skill
  \item corruption, an institution, a ban, string-pulling, transparent
  \item a rally, a head of an organisation, a district, a majority, to spurn
  \item despite, besides, even though, however, to give in
  \item mercy, sympathy, loyal, a sin, to hold on to
  \item a possibility, scope, a coincidence, a probability, to go by
  \item an estimate, certainty, often, conjecture, to work out a riddle
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Praise? (\textbf{\ur{تعریف}}, \emph{tārīf}.) Fault? (\textbf{\ur{قصور}}, \emph{qusūr}.) Reproach? (\textbf{\ur{ملامت}}, \emph{malāmat}.) To commend? (\textbf{\ur{سراہنا}}, \emph{sarāhnā}.) To endure? (\textbf{\ur{جھیلنا}}, \emph{jhelnā}.) A reform? (\textbf{\ur{اصلاح}}, \emph{islāh}.) A standard? (\textbf{\ur{معیار}}, \emph{meyār}.) A knack? (\textbf{\ur{سلیقہ}}, \emph{salīqā}.) To put right? (\textbf{\ur{سدھارنا}}, \emph{sudhārnā}.) To polish a skill? (\textbf{\ur{نکھارنا}}, \emph{nikhārnā}.) Corruption? (\textbf{\ur{بدعنوانی}}, \emph{badunvānī}.) An institution? (\textbf{\ur{ادارہ}}, \emph{idārā}.) A ban? (\textbf{\ur{پابندی}}, \emph{pābandī}.) String-pulling? (\textbf{\ur{سفارش}}, \emph{sifārish}.) Transparent? (\textbf{\ur{شفاف}}, \emph{shaffāf}.) A rally? (\textbf{\ur{جلسہ}}, \emph{jalsā}.) A head of an organisation? (\textbf{\ur{سربراہ}}, \emph{sarbarāh}.) A district? (\textbf{\ur{ضلع}}, \emph{zilā}.) A majority? (\textbf{\ur{اکثریت}}, \emph{aksariyat}.) To spurn? (\textbf{\ur{ٹھکرانا}}, \emph{ṭhukrānā}.) Despite? (\textbf{\ur{باوجود}}, \emph{bāvujūd}.) Besides? (\textbf{\ur{علاوہ}}, \emph{alāvā}.) Even though? (\textbf{\ur{اگرچہ}}, \emph{agarche}.) However? (\textbf{\ur{البتہ}}, \emph{albattā}.) To give in? (\textbf{\ur{جھکنا}}, \emph{jhuknā}.) Mercy? (\textbf{\ur{رحم}}, \emph{rahm}.) Sympathy? (\textbf{\ur{ہمدردی}}, \emph{hamdardī}.) Loyal? (\textbf{\ur{وفادار}}, \emph{vafādār}.) A sin? (\textbf{\ur{گناہ}}, \emph{gunāh}.) To hold on to? (\textbf{\ur{تھامنا}}, \emph{thāmnā}.) A possibility? (\textbf{\ur{امکان}}, \emph{imkān}.) Scope? (\textbf{\ur{گنجائش}}, \emph{gunjāish}.) A coincidence? (\textbf{\ur{اتفاق}}, \emph{ittifāq}.) A probability? (\textbf{\ur{احتمال}}, \emph{ehtimāl}.) To go by? (\textbf{\ur{بیتنا}}, \emph{bītnā}.) An estimate? (\textbf{\ur{تخمینہ}}, \emph{takhmīnā}.) Certainty? (\textbf{\ur{یقین}}, \emph{yaqīn}.) Often? (\textbf{\ur{اکثر}}, \emph{aksar}.) Conjecture? (\textbf{\ur{قیاس}}, \emph{qiyās}.) To work out a riddle? (\textbf{\ur{بوجھنا}}, \emph{būjhnā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
